_comment: v1.12.2 - the third and last De Bello Civili batch: Book III (13), which finishes the work and the whole Corpus except Hirtius. The failed peace on the Apsus, the famine and Scaeva at Dyrrachium, the near-victory Pompey did not press, the enemy dividing the spoils before the battle, both battle plans at Pharsalus, Crastinus, the charge, the fourth line, the camp and the flight, the reckoning, and the murder of Pompey. All thirteen are whole chapters. Source defects: III.53 ends with no full stop, and III.94 prints `Pornpeiana` for `Pompeiana`.
